correctness.rationale: Every maximal face of the triple join has 2 vertices in each of the three polygon factors. Triangles have occupancy (1,1,1) or (2,1,0); their complementary 3-faces yield exactly C_m x C_n x C_l and 3 products C_i x K_{lengths}, disjointly. Shared synchronized walk parity gives t=2^max(b-1,0) components of the first product and 1+1[even length] for each other; each component is a graph and collapses to E-V+1 circles. Algebra gives beta_1=9mnl-2(mn+ml+nl)+t+3+b; all-square case gives 10 components each a wedge of 49 circles. Independently built all six-faces and full three-tuple graph for seven test triples spanning all b=0..3 regimes and checked integral component graph ranks.
residual_risks: Finite graph construction is not universal proof; synchronized-walk argument and incidence classification cover all stated m,n,l>=4.
